race.comment: Wide open race. TEXTURE (7) landed his maiden success over this course and distance two back and has since won again here on Saturday. Copped a 2kg penalty but can bring up the winning hat-trick if lining up again. BIT TIRED ACTUALLY (10) resumes from a spell of 11 weeks and is having her first outing under new trainer Philip Cole. Finished seventh at Bunbury over 1200m at the opening run last time in work. Has ability and makes plenty of appeal. FIELD OF PRAISE (12) turned in a modest performance when seventh last time out over 1300m at this track, beaten 9 lengths, after a win at this track at the previous outing. Likely improver with top-three prospects. ANECDOTAL (2) is racing well and will give backers a sight.  SI SENORA (13) is better than last run and can give a sight.
